brief: A village house at night: two dusty travelling scholars with cloth bundles sitting in the courtyard with a lamp; in the lane beyond, a travelling actor dancing to a drum, torch-lit; a small boy of seven watching from the doorway, head tilted, listening; his mother in the doorway beside him.

The courtyard of a poor mud-walled house in Pāṭaliputra: the thin teacher Varṣa seated on swept ground speaking, three boys sitting cross-legged before him with a small boy in front, eyes closed, listening; townsfolk gathering at the gate with folded hands; a royal messenger with a gift tray arriving.

A quiet courtyard school in Pāṭaliputra: a thin earnest young man in plain white with a shaved head and a bundle of palm leaves sitting a little apart from the other pupils, slow and sorrowful; the teacher Varṣa's wife at a doorway making a gentle but firm gesture of dismissal; warm old-India watercolour.

A high Himālayan slope with snow peaks and dark pines: the thin young man seated cross-legged on a flat rock beside a tiny fire, eyes closed in austerity, snow on his shoulders; above him on the peak a serene ascetic figure with a thin crescent moon in his matted hair, hand raised in blessing; drifting cloud; soft gold light.

A deep dry well in a palace courtyard: a lean grey-bearded minister in a dusty cream robe being slowly hauled up on a rope by two guards, blinking in the light; a calm tall scholar-minister in white standing at the rim watching; a proud king in red and gold looking on from a balcony in the background.

The wide pale Gaṅgā at morning with a hand with five spread fingers rising from the water; a proud king in red and gold on the brick steps pointing in astonishment; a calm tall scholar-minister beside him holding up two fingers of one hand; a lean grey-bearded man a little behind, looking downcast.

A lean grey-bearded minister bowing deeply before a proud king in a pillared hall, his bent back like a reed in a breeze; behind him through an arch the calm tall scholar-minister watching him with narrowed eyes; a long reed bending in a vase on a table in the foreground.

The clearing at dawn: the fire burnt low, grey ash in the stone pit; the young king, humbled, kneeling before the lean bearded poet and holding out both hands; the poet offering a single small bundle of palm leaves; two disciples behind; a few small blue-lit ghosts at the clearing's edge, arriving too late, watching from between the trees.
